description: Full recompute of one receipt from the public log: log chain intact, issuer Ed25519 signature, issuer registration/class, per-issuer chain link, approval binding, outcome, disputes and countersignatures. Returns the per-check verdict object — never a bare boolean. Give receipt_id, or a full receipt object (its signature is checked and it is compared byte-for-byte with the log entry).

receipt.description: A full receipt object to verify
